title: A Narwhal's 8 Foot Tusk Is a Tooth With 10 Million Nerve Endings

scenes.text: A narwhal's tusk is a tooth with ten million nerve endings.
It grows up to eight feet long, out through the whale's lip.
Under a microscope, scientists found millions of nerves running from the surface to the core.
It can sense salt, temperature and pressure in the water.
When captured whales were tested with salty water, their hearts sped up.
It's not just a spear. It's a tooth that feels the ocean.

description:
A narwhal's spiral tusk is a tooth that can reach eight feet long and contains about 10 million nerve connections.
Researchers think it senses salt, temperature and pressure.
Would you want a tooth that feels the ocean?
first_comment: Did you know the narwhal is called the unicorn of the sea? What would you call it?
